journey.name: EXC-05: 快速重复点击与防抖测试
journey.description: 验证在网关连接提交、消息发送、新建对话等高频关键交互按钮上，进行快速连续敲击测试，防抖机制生效，确保只触发一次有效网络调用，杜绝重复创建或数据污染。

actions.action: Click the message input field "输入消息或 / 命令..."
Type "Single atomic dispatch under rapid clicks test" into the input field
Quickly click the "发送" button 5 times in rapid succession
Verify that the message input field is cleared after the first dispatch
Verify that only one message instance was submitted to the timeline
Verify that no duplicated message bubbles are rendered
